native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'sevseg1': '0', 'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'servo3': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. At 0.5 seconds, the 7-segment display shows 0, and all servos are at their initial position of 0 degrees.'}

test2: {'time': 3, 'state': {'sevseg1': '1', 'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '45 degrees', 'servo3': '90 degrees'}, 'description': 'First number increment. At 3 seconds (0.5 + 2.5), the display shows 1. Since 1 is in range 0-2, servo1 is at 0°, servo2 at 45°, and servo3 at 90°.'}

test3: {'time': 7.5, 'state': {'sevseg1': '3', 'servo1': '45 degrees', 'servo2': '90 degrees', 'servo3': '135 degrees'}, 'description': 'Second number increment. At 7.5 seconds (3 + 4.5), the display shows 3. Since 3 is in range 3-5, servo1 is at 45°, servo2 at 90°, and servo3 at 135°.'}

test4: {'time': 20, 'state': {'sevseg1': '9', 'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'servo3': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Ninth number display. At 20 seconds (7.5 + 12.5), the display shows 9. For number 9, all servos return to 0 degrees.'}

test5: {'time': 30, 'state': {'sevseg1': '4', 'servo1': '45 degrees', 'servo2': '90 degrees', 'servo3': '135 degrees'}, 'description': 'Cycle continuation after reset. At 30 seconds (20 + 10), the display has reset to 0 and incremented to 4. Since 4 is in range 3-5, servo1 is at 45°, servo2 at 90°, and servo3 at 135°.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
